summary: security checked in 1 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Recommendation: permit isolated dependency-repair pull requests, but block production merge or release for weirdgirlstore.com, weapontester.com, and saveusfarms.com until npm run security:audit:prod and build gates pass. Evidence: GitHub verification reports devalue <=5.9.2, undici <=7.29.0, and http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0; the cache dependency has no published patch. Fleet-doctor has no run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, and security site facts are unknown. This supports a high release/supply-chain risk, not proof of exploitation. TLS has no recorded expirations within 30 days, but complete TLS configuration, authentication boundaries, secrets handling, isolation, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Do not suppress audits, downgrade blindly, merge, or deploy until the repair evidence is complete.
